entities.name: Mount Kireshal
entities.description: High snow-covered peak in the Karplusan Mountains on Terisiare, above Balesh Pass.

entities.name: Mount Delapre
entities.description: Peak a two-days walk from Mount Kireshal.

entities.name: Groth Jonar
entities.description: Balduvian orc general who met his two clan chiefs on Kireshal.

entities.name: Jel
entities.description: Clan chief persuaded by Groth Jonar to accept goblins of the Flarg.

entities.name: Lavash
entities.description: Clan chief persuaded by Groth Jonar to accept goblins of the Flarg.

entities.name: Flarg
entities.description: Irregular goblin troops Groth wanted integrated into the clans.

events.summary: Groth Jonar met chiefs Jel and Lavash on Kireshal and convinced them to accept the Flarg goblins into their ranks.
events.quote: Groth convinced the two chiefs to accept goblins of the Flarg into their ranks

relations.quote: Mount Kireshal was a high peak in the Karplusan Mountains
